title: 받아쓰기 1: 모음 — 고기예요? 거기예요?
objective: You can hear the difference between ㅓ/ㅗ and ㅜ/ㅡ and write each word with the right vowel.
summary: Practice hearing and writing four vowels that English speakers often mix up: ㅓ, ㅗ, ㅜ and ㅡ.

task.title: Hear it, write it
task.line: Use the meaning and the sound in [ ] to pick or write the right vowel.

letters.sound: [어] Mouth open, jaw low, lips relaxed and not rounded.
letters.as: Like 'u' in 'cup', but deeper in the throat.

letters.sound: [오] Lips make a small, tight circle. Jaw stays higher than for ㅓ.
letters.as: Like 'o' in 'go', but with no 'w' sound at the end.

letters.sound: [으] Lips flat and spread, teeth almost closed, tongue pulled back.
letters.as: No English match. Say 'oo' while smiling.

exercises: Write the missing syllable. It has ㅓ or ㅗ: ① ____디 [eodi] where ② ____리 [sori] sound ③ 서____ [seoro] each other
Write the missing syllable. It has ㅜ or ㅡ: ① ____스 [juseu] juice ② 나____ [namu] tree ③ ____리고 [geurigo] and
Write the word in Hangul: ① [eomeoni] mother ② [nuna] older sister (said by a man) ③ [moja] hat
Each sentence has one wrong vowel. Write the sentence correctly: ① 두브 사요. (I'm buying tofu.) ② 치마가 너모 커요. (The skirt is too big.)
answers: ① 어 (어디) ② 소 (소리) ③ 로 (서로)
① 주 (주스) ② 무 (나무) ③ 그 (그리고)
① 어머니 ② 누나 ③ 모자
① 두부 사요. ② 치마가 너무 커요.
